messages:
Sam: Starting percent-shuttle rollout v12.1 -> 15% eu-west now. Change window: 23:00-01:00 UTC. Release notes pinned in #release-notes. @Nadia @Priya please call GO/STOP.
Nadia: Confirming binary pinned: v12.1 (sha1: 3a7f9c2). Docs updated.
Priya: Quick check — what are canary metrics we're watching?
Sam: 1) 95p latency 2) error rate 3) embed mismatch. Use `curl` to query dashboard: `curl -s "https://ops.internal/metrics?service=shuttle&env=canary" | jq .`
deploy-bot: percent-shuttle canary: started -> 15% (eu-west). Instances: 24. Health: initializing.
Miguel: Observing a short spike in 95p in eu-west ~+120ms at t+3m. Not seeing errors.
Priya: Are KV cache misses increased? That'd explain tail.
Sam: KV miss +2% per telemetry. Binding autoscale holding.
Nadia: Suggest holding at 15% for 20m and run A/B eval on prompt set-21. If stable, continue.
Priya: +1 to hold. I'll run eval now and post summary.
deploy-bot: telemetry snapshot: 95p latency +110ms, error_rate steady 0.03%, kv_miss +1.9%, requests: 12k/min.
Priya: Eval summary (quick): sample size 500 -> quality parity 98.6%, slight length variance on one prompt. No critical regressions.
Sam: Ok consensus = HOLD. Putting a tag `shuttle/paused-15pct` and creating follow-up ticket INF-2389 for KV tuning. @Miguel can you triage infra?
Miguel: On it. I'll collect flamegraphs and KV histograms, will update thread.
Sam: Thanks. Rolling back is OFF unless we see error_rate >0.5% or 95p >300ms. Everyone stay tuned :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: percent-shuttle canary: paused at 15% by human. Ops incident channel notified.
Nadia: I'll draft a short blurb for release notes about the pause and next steps.
Sam: Great, closing this coordination thread. New updates go in INF-2389 or here.
